title: China rejects PNG artillery shell claim, says object is a wine bottle
text:
What is it? PNG says it’s an artillery shell. China says it’s a wine bottle | South China Morning Post Diplomacy - Diplomacy China rejects PNG artillery shell claim, says object is a wine bottle 4 Advertisement Pacific nations China Diplomacy What is it? PNG says it’s an artillery shell. China says it’s a wine bottle 
 4 Chinese nationals arrested, bomb squad deployed following discovery of suspected artillery round in a commercial shipping container
 2 -MIN READ 2 -MIN 4 Listen Cao Jiaxuan in Beijing Published: 5:59pm, 3 Nov 2026 Updated: 6:18pm, 3 Nov 2026 China’s embassy in Papua New Guinea has disputed reports that a suspected Chinese-made artillery shell was found in a shipping container in Port Moresby, saying the object was instead a shell-shaped wine bottle. The embassy said in a social media post on Tuesday it was awaiting the official findings of an investigation by the Royal Papua New Guinea Constabulary (RPNGC).
 It cited an on-site verification by a company involved in the case, which said the object was a wine bottle. “It poses no danger at all,” the embassy said.
